title: Draw a sound map
summary: Listen from a comfortable spot and sketch the sounds around you.
steps: Sit somewhere comfortable with paper and a pencil.
Listen quietly, then mark where each sound seems to come from.
Give each sound a shape and compare your map with what you can see.

title: Find a color collection
summary: Notice different shades of one color using objects already nearby.
steps: Choose a color and look for it in your room.
Point out five examples without moving heavy or fragile objects.
Arrange the examples in your imagination from lightest to darkest.

title: Make an imaginary postcard
summary: Invent a place and send a short message from it on paper.
steps: Sketch an imaginary place on a sheet of paper.
Name the place and add three details that make it unusual.
Write a short postcard describing something you noticed there.
